gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients diagnosed with essential hypertension and registered in the cardiology and medical Outpatient Departments (OPDs) of three tertiary care hospitals of Lahore for the last one month.

candidate_evidence.quote: [BEHAVIORAL] mHealth using"WhatsApp" multifaceted educational and reminder module intervention to improve adherence

coder_notes: Not a glioma trial: 'GBM' in the record stands for Graphic-based Messages in a hypertension medication-adherence mHealth trial (not glioblastoma and not anti-GBM disease). Behavioural intervention only.
